content:
FINAL REMAINING COMPLETION — DO NOT REPEAT COMPLETED RECOVERY WORK

The clean GitHub source, Render cutover, and Rork source-dependency removal are accepted as substantially completed.

Complete only the remaining acceptance items below.

==================================================
1. FIX BACKEND TESTS
==================================================

Current reported result:

- 2,150 passed
- 35 failed
- 18 errors

For every failed or errored test, return:

- test file
- test name
- exact error
- stack trace summary
- root-cause category
- code defect or environment defect
- corrective action
- rerun result

Run the complete backend suite in GitHub Actions from a fresh clone.

Required final result:

- all critical backend tests pass
- zero unexplained failures
- zero unexplained errors
- no skipped security or authentication tests

Do not classify a failure as “sandbox-related” without GitHub Actions evidence.

==================================================
2. FIX TYPESCRIPT
==================================================

Current reported result:

- Backend TypeScript: 2 errors

Fix both errors and rerun:

- backend TypeScript
- Expo TypeScript
- lint
- tests

Required result:

- TypeScript: 0 errors
- no suppressed errors added
- no unsafe broad any-casts used only to silence compilation

==================================================
3. REBUILD APK FROM FINAL SHA
==================================================

The previous APK was built from c1677d…, but the final production and Rork-removal SHA is reported as 190fa618….

Build a new signed release APK from the current final GitHub main SHA.

Before building, verify:

GitHub main SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
runtime /health SHA

Return:

- APK filename
- version
- versionCode
- source SHA
- SHA-256
- file size
- signing type
- GitHub Actions run ID
- permanent owner-controlled download location

Do not use a temporary tmpfiles.org or Rork download link.

==================================================
4. REAL ANDROID DEVICE QA
==================================================

Install the new APK built from the final SHA on a physical Android device.

Test:

1. Installation
2. Launch
3. Owner login
4. Invalid password
5. Logout
6. Session persistence
7. App restart
8. Home feed
9. Investment Card
10. Reel Card
11. View Deal
12. Invest Now
13. Registration
14. Messages
15. Notifications
16. Image upload
17. Video upload
18. PDF upload
19. Profile
20. Settings
21. Owner controls
22. Network interruption
23. Network recovery
24. No crash
25. No infinite loading
26. No page jumping

Return:

- device model
- Android version
- APK version
- source SHA
- PASS/FAIL per test
- timestamps
- screenshots or logs
- trace IDs for failures

File existence or emulator-only checks do not count as real-device QA.

==================================================
5. ROTATE OWNER CREDENTIALS
==================================================

Rotate:

- GITHUB_TOKEN
- RENDER_API_KEY
- SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
- exposed or Rork-accessible AI-provider credentials
- other production credentials previously accessible to Rork

Requirements:

- replacements created by owner
- replacements stored in owner-controlled secret stores
- old credentials revoked
- no full secret printed
- production retested after rotation
- redacted rotation report produced

==================================================
6. MOVE BACKUP OUTSIDE RORK
==================================================

Upload the recovery archive to an owner-controlled location.

After upload:

- download or inspect the remote object
- calculate SHA-256
- compare it with the original SHA-256
- confirm file size
- record storage location and timestamp

The Rork workspace must not remain the only backup location.

==================================================
7. COMPLETE FINAL RORK INDEPENDENCE TEST
==================================================

Run from a clean environment with no Rork workspace access.

Verify:

- fresh clone succeeds
- dependency installation succeeds
- backend starts
- Expo tests pass
- backend tests pass
- TypeScript passes
- worker starts
- scheduler starts
- GitHub commit/push works
- Render deploy works
- production verification works
- no request is made to a Rork domain
- no Rork token or environment variable is required

Run network and source scans.

Required final result:

- Rork runtime dependencies: 0
- Rork API calls: 0
- Rork credentials: 0
- Rork workspace paths: 0
- Rork deployment hooks: 0

==================================================
8. PROVE IVX IA SENIOR-DEVELOPER LOOP
==================================================

Run one real controlled engineering task entirely through IVX IA.

The task must require a real code change and test.

IVX IA must independently:

1. Receive the owner request.
2. Select the correct repository.
3. Inspect the related code.
4. Create a branch.
5. Implement the change.
6. Create or update tests.
7. Run tests.
8. Diagnose any failure.
9. Fix the failure.
10. Review the diff.
11. Commit.
12. Push.
13. Run CI.
14. Deploy.
15. Verify production.
16. Save evidence.
17. Post the result in IVX IA Chat.

Return:

- job ID
- task IDs
- repository
- branch
- starting SHA
- final SHA
- files changed
- test results
- CI run ID
- deployment ID
- production URL
- runtime SHA
- verification evidence
- final status

Rork may observe the test, but Rork must not perform the engineering actions for IVX IA.

==================================================
9. VERIFY TWO-HOUR REPORTING
==================================================

Prove three consecutive automatic IVX IA Chat reports.

Return:

- report IDs
- conversation ID
- scheduled timestamps
- actual delivery timestamps
- database rows
- worker heartbeat
- completed tasks
- failed tasks
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- next work queue

Restart the worker between reports and prove reporting resumes without duplication.

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do not mark 100% complete until all are true:

- backend critical tests pass
- TypeScript has zero errors
- APK is rebuilt from the final production SHA
- APK passes real-device QA
- credentials are owner-controlled and rotated
- backup exists outside Rork
- independent clean-environment test passes
- IVX IA completes a real engineering task end to end
- three automatic two-hour reports are proven
- active Rork runtime dependencies remain zero

Return a final PASS/FAIL table with evidence for every requirement.
